heading: Goals for financial management and academic program

tree.heading: Goals
tree.text: Any application for a grant under this part shall describe measurable goals for the institution’s financial management and academic programs, and include a plan of how the applicant intends to achieve those goals.

tree.heading: Continuation requirements
tree.text: Any continuation application shall demonstrate the progress made toward achievement of the goals described pursuant to subsection (a).

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Oct. 1, 1992, see section 2 of Pub. L. 102–325, set out as an Effective Date of 1992 Amendment note under section 1001 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 89–329, title III, § 315, as added Pub. L. 102–325, title III, § 302(d)(1), July 23, 1992, 106 Stat. 472.)
